notes.title: SUPPORT US IN THE STEAM AWARDS.
notes.notes:
OUR LAST CHANCE TO ESCAPE THE HENTAI VOID!

Listen up, everyone: we’ve been making hentai games, and while it’s been a wild ride, we’re ready to leave this spicy world behind. We’ve got dreams—big ones! Maybe we’ll make a game about heroic pigeons saving the world or a drama-filled adventure with a sentient toaster. Who knows? But to make it happen, we need your help!

Nominate this masterpiece for the Steam Awards and become the hero who helps us break free from the endless loop of drawing jiggly bits. Support us, and together we can say goodbye to hentai and hello to our dream games.

Let’s do this—because nobody wants to be stuck in hentai forever! 🚀
